metas.name: 777 Charlie
metas.description: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named Charlie who is naughty and energetic which is a complete contrast with the Dharma’s character enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.

metas.name: Thota Kovi
metas.description: A witty crime-drama set in the western ghats of Karnataka.

metas.name: Full Meals
metas.description: Full Meals movie touches upon Love, Life, and Passion. In the Film, protagonist is a struggling Wedding Photographer who tries to attain his passion and prove himself. In this process he gets entangled in his personal and love life

metas.name: Dakota Express
metas.description: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.

metas.name: Rambo
metas.description: Car brokers Kitty and Premkumar come across a vehicle that contains a corpse. Soon, they learn that the body has a pen drive that holds information about a terrorist plot.

metas.name: Brindavihari
metas.description: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

metas.name: Masala
metas.description: Three medical college students (Sunil,Vishal and Nagsekhar) are the witnesses to a murder. The goons chase them as the boys escape but their ID cards are with the goons. Now the police are on their trail as they are in disguise of females. They come to ladies hostel and meets Radhika, Suja and Sandhya who extend support as they are convinced that the boys are innocent. They work out a plan to bring the real killers in front of the law with the help of a lie detector.

metas.name: Veera Madakari
metas.description: Madakar is an honest police officer who is murdered by a local thug, Babji, and his son Munna. After his death, his daughter is mysteriously left at the door of Sathyaraju, Madakar's lookalike.

metas.name: Bank Of Bhagyalakshmi
metas.description: A crew of five amateur thieves reunite for one final score in a village brimming with elections. With no experience and only a reckless plan, things dont go as expected.  Will they make it out, or will the village remember them only as five fools who gambled with fate?

metas.name: The Devil
metas.description: Rajashekar (Chief Minister of Karnataka) is framed, so his secretary recruits Krishna, a kindhearted lookalike, to impersonate the violent heir Dhanush. When the real Dhanush returns, both men clash for political power and Rukmini’s love. Krishna must protect Rukmini from Dhanush while also rising as a leader the people trust.

metas.name: Josh
metas.description: Rockey, the son of a middle-class couple, falls in love with Meena and ignores his studies. While his friends pass with flying colors, Rockey is love-struck. When he comes to know he cannot win over Meena, he falls in love with Meera who also rejects him. Aside from Rockey's path, "Josh" also follows Robo Meena, Meera, and Sneha's path who struggle with their studies. In this coming-of-age story, the decisions each student takes will drastically impact who they become by the end of the film.

metas.name: Sri Ranga
metas.description: Sri Ranga's tech savvy mother is looking for a good match for him. What will happen when he likes 2 girls?

metas.name: Ramana Avatara
metas.description: A jovial guy named Rama Krishna who wants to be a political leader, goes through a series of uncontrollable situations that end up being lessons of life and help him become a true leader.

metas.name: Aachar & Co
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of 1960s Bangalore, Aachar & Co. follows the journey of a traditional family as they navigate the challenges of embracing modernity while honouring their roots. The film brings together a delightful mix of nostalgia, humour, and drama, capturing the essence of that era.

metas.name: Simple Agi Ondh Love Story
metas.description: Rachana persuades her brother to meet her boyfriend's sister, Ithihasini, hoping that cupid would strike them. However, things take a turn when another girl tricks him into falling in love with her.

metas.name: Software Ganda
metas.description: Manu, a software engineer, faces difficulty working under Priya, his short-tempered NRI boss. Priya is forced to leave India due to visa issues and she decides to marry Manu for her selfish needs.

metas.name: Flirt
metas.description: Flirt is a romantic-comedy-thriller centered around a young man (portrayed by Chandan Kumar) whose life intertwines with love, friendship and emotional chaos. The film explores relationships, romance and unexpected twists in an entertaining blend of humour, drama and heart. Performances especially by the lead pair are highlighted as the film’s strongest aspect.

metas.name: Mutthanna
metas.description: A man and his sister are held at ransom when a rich lookalike, who moonlights as a diamond thief, forces him to take his place at social events so that the thief can carry out his illegal activities.

metas.name: Hondisi Bareyiri
metas.description: A story of a bunch of college friends who reunite after many years. It focuses on their college life, leading to the responsibilities of adulthood and their struggle to find solace amidst their complex relationships.

metas.name: Love OTP
metas.description: Akshay finds himself in a hilarious mess when he falls in love with two girls at the same time, without either of them knowing. To make things worse, his strict father is completely against love. Now, Akshay must juggle both sides, hide the truth, and somehow escape the chaos hes created.

metas.name: Power
metas.description: A politician slips into coma after being attacked by criminals. He wakes up several years later to find his son having taken up his responsibilities. However, things are not what they seem to be.

metas.name: Kubera
metas.description: A few business tycoons regularly consult Kubera to find solutions to their several critical problems. However, an unexpected turn of events puts him in dire straits.

metas.name: Maanikya
metas.description: Vijay and Manasa's families have been at each other's throat's since the past 25 years. However, things take a turn when they fall in love with each other.

metas.name: James
metas.description: Santhosh Kumar, who goes by the name James, runs a security agency and has been commissioned to take care of a family that owns a drug cartel. He is swift, agile and deft with his work and wins the appreciation of everyone. But is there more to who Santhosh really is?

metas.name: Badava Rascal
metas.description: Badava Rascal is the journey of Shankar who lives life on his own terms. When he gets kidnapped along with his friend over trivial issues by goons, how does he get out of the trouble and what is the motto of abduction unravels the theme of the story.

metas.name: Sarala Subbarao
metas.description: A romantic family drama set in 1970s Mysore that portrays the journey of Sarala and Subbarao as they balance love, tradition, and aspirations.

metas.name: Driver Hanumanthu
metas.description: Two close friends get into trouble when another friend intrudes into their lives with a personal motive.

metas.name: Rippan Swamy
metas.description: In the fictional town of sanna koppa ,the story begins with santhosh's murder.as the investigation unfolds ,Rippan swamy dives into a gripping psychological rural thriller set amidst estate workers ,town homes and hidden conflicts.

metas.name: Nannavalu Nannavalu
metas.description: Chandu can inherit her ancestor's wealth only if she gets married. She wants the wealth all for herself and marries Gopi, as she is told that he will not live long due to a hole in his heart.

metas.name: Vishnuvardhana
metas.description: No one has entered a biography for him.

metas.name: Paramathma
metas.description: The story of Paramathma focus on the philosophy that those who are very close to heart leave us quickly. A section of the society believes this and longevity is cut short by destiny as villain.

metas.name: Server Somanna
metas.description: Somanna, an aspiring actor who works as a waiter gets a break in the film industry with the help of his friend. However, stardom takes away his happiness, forcing him to take a tough decision.
